clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Glyphic Memorandum sends novice mages to Anvilmar. Marryk Nurribit wrote it to guide arriving spellcasters into formal arcane instruction.

Novice spellcasters receive the Glyphic Memorandum after finishing their first tasks in Coldridge Valley. Marryk Nurribit, the local mage trainer, calls them inside Anvilmar. His advice is plain: learn your incantations, save coin for training and tavern ale, and keep clear of Gnomeregan, ruined by radiation.
